entries.topic: Historical Tabula Rasa Pravus squad footage
entries.fact: Original player-view footage of a Wilderness Pravus run, uploaded 2009-01-21, shows a three-person squad moving and fighting outdoors at 00:30 and indoors at 05:00 and 07:00. Its capture date and client build are unverified. Use it as historical group-behavior context only; it does not establish final-live encounter rules, bot routes, combat timings, rewards, or current bot capability.

entries.topic: Historical Tabula Rasa D11 exercise clip provenance
entries.fact: The 2008-08-08 D11 boot-camp exercise clip shows rows of recruits exercising around 00:20. Its uploader explicitly identifies the Public Test Server. This clip does not verify that those recruits, placements, animations or schedules survived unchanged on the final live service.

entries.topic: Historical Tabula Rasa player event footage
entries.fact: The July 25, 2008 Friday Night Fights footage shows players gathering around a boxing event near 00:30. The August 2, 2008 Olympics opening and June 2008 blind race videos also document player-organized social events. These edited event clips are historical context, not evidence that ordinary NPCs or companions should join, spectate or reproduce those events.

In original player-view footage uploaded in 2012 (recording date and build unknown), Warrior Apirka completes Conscientious Objector around 24:52 with +2,000 XP, then offers Conscientious Objector - Part Two around 24:55 with the objective Bring the report to Rogers. This supports the current shard’s Apirka giver and Rogers receiver. The video does not establish final-live item rewards or which Part Two branch ID is shown; companions cannot accept or turn in quests autonomously.
